entries.what: Linh sits in the Pell Road kitchen drafting how to tell Thao about public health, and asks the assistant for help wording it, hoping Thao will be the one to break it to Hạnh.
entries.outcome: Draft ready, but she wants Thao to handle telling their mom.

entries.what: Before her Monday shift at Heron & Grind she catches Thao at the apartment after a night shift and tells her she is considering a public health or nutrition transfer instead of pharmacy. She goes to Thao before anyone else because Thao is the one who will not freak out.
entries.outcome: Thao takes it calmly and agrees not to push; Linh feels lighter.

entries.what: Closing shift at Heron & Grind, Mon 3-9, logging milk waste and locking the vault-room outlets; Jun jokes about her latte art.
entries.outcome: Closed on time and got home to a plate Hạnh left out.

entries.what: Veterans Day: no classes. Linh sleeps in, then plans her week in her washi-tape planner and reviews her 600-card anatomy deck.
entries.outcome: Week planned in color; chem problem set done.

entries.what: Kenji gives her a ride to the library to study, since the holiday means the campus is closed, and they work at tables near the stacks.
entries.outcome: Linh gets through chemistry notes; she does not mention the Thao talk yet.

entries.what: Dinner at home on Pell Road with Hạnh, who talks about salon customers; Linh says nothing about the pharmacy talk.
entries.outcome: Peaceful dinner, topic avoided.

entries.what: Anatomy with Dr. Okoye at 9, sitting beside Rochelle, then a quick flashcard review before heading to work.
entries.outcome: Took color-coded notes on the digestive system.

entries.what: Closing shift at Heron & Grind, Wed 3-9; Wes calls her Doc as he stops in for a late tea.
entries.outcome: Smooth shift; she ate her packed rice bowl on break.

entries.what: Late at night she texts Thao a thank-you for not telling Hạnh anything yet.
entries.outcome: Thao replies with a thumbs up and a reminder to eat.

entries.what: First fall storm: rain floods the streets and Tule Line delays hit; Linh bikes to campus in the downpour for General Chemistry at 11.
entries.outcome: Arrived damp but on time.

entries.what: At the library after class she arranges a ride through Kenji for Pedro's bone-model kit to the study spot, then bikes home soaked herself.
entries.outcome: The bone kit stayed dry; Linh got a cold and wet socks.

entries.what: She warms up at home with tea and a hot shower, then reviews flashcards in bed.
entries.outcome: Hạnh scolds her about the bike in the rain.

entries.what: The storm keeps up on Friday. Linh skips the bike, catches the shuttle bus to campus and takes notes in the nutrition-heavy digestion unit.
entries.outcome: Solid notes and a dry commute.

entries.what: Quick phở with Thao at Phở Bến Thành after Thao's night shift, where the two talk about the public health idea.
entries.outcome: Thao suggests Linh look up Bayshore's program details.

entries.what: Evening study session at home with Vietnamese ballads on the radio.
entries.outcome: Finished the stats module due Sunday.

entries.what: Saturday opening shift at Heron & Grind, 6:30-1, with Sam swapping around on the schedule.
entries.outcome: Busy morning; Sam owes her shifts still.

entries.what: Jun asks her to look at a Lola's Roll pricing tweak on the sheet during the afternoon lull.
entries.outcome: She updates the numbers in ten minutes.

entries.what: After work she walks home along damp streets and rests with her planner.
entries.outcome: Planned out Sunday and priority registration prep.

entries.what: Sunday shift at Heron & Grind 6:30-1, then helps at Lotus Nails' front desk from 2 to 5.
entries.outcome: Hạnh brags about her latte art to a customer.

entries.what: That evening she asks the assistant for a script for registering for nutrition without making it a whole thing at home.
entries.outcome: Gets a short script and feels more ready.

entries.what: Sunday planning night with her washi-tape planner, laying out the week and registration morning.
entries.outcome: Week mapped, alarm set.
